$comment: Authored asset map for the 8-stage Contra asset library. Consumed by tools/assets/build-asset-manifest.mjs. Binary files are NEVER copied into public/assets/ — entries reference real files by relative path (shared assets are referenced, not duplicated).

licensePolicy.note: Assets without a verified license may be used for local development only. The runtime registry refuses to load non-publishable assets in publish mode.

player.sheet.title: 角色精灵总表（比尔 + 红色突击兵）
player.sheet.licenseBasis: Konami NES rip supplied by the user for local use; no distribution right. Local-only, gitignored.

titan.character: Lance / P2 + enemy infantry (palette-shared, faithful to the original)

sourceSheet.note: Slicing/trim/align/scale pipeline lives in src/gfx/pack.ts (verified). Enemy infantry reuses the right column — the original has no separate enemy sheet.
Authoritative weapon letters are overlaid at render time from weaponDef() (baked letters are misaligned in the sheet).
